title: Mob Programming Basics – Mob Programming
summary: Woody Zuill describes the mob programming setup: one driver typing what navigators say, 15-minute rotation, shared work area, with the claim that this spreads knowledge and skills fast.

assertions.quote: the real work of software development is the problem solving, not the typing
we transfer knowledge quickly througout the team which quickly improves everyones coding skills
We rotate the Driver every 15 minutes.

verdicts.note: Engagement is self-reported; no comparative data.

assertions.quote: If the Driver is not highly skilled, the rest of the team will help by guiding the Driver in how to create the code

verdicts.note: Case reports from Hunter Industries and others are positive; no controlled studies.
